title: spot breakdown by ear
system_instruction_addendum: SPOT BREAKDOWN EAR ADDENDUM: The breakdown is the energy drop: usually the kick steps out and a sustained chord or vocal carries through. State the audible cue, not the bar number.

tutor_speak.text: the breakdown is the moment the energy thins: the kick steps out, a chord or vocal hangs in the air.
listen for it. tap continue the instant you hear the kick disappear.

hints.text: the loudest thing in the mix is usually the kick: wait for it to stop.
when the room would feel quieter and the chord takes over: that is it.
tap continue the moment the kick falls away.
